{
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Each hollow rectangular frame contains an encoded pattern in its color arrangement.
    # Transfer internal pattern from irregular frame to a matching plain frame of equal interior size.
    frames=[]
    colors=set(sum(grid,[]))-{0}
    for c in colors:
        pts=[(r,k) for r in range(h) for k in range(w) if grid[r][k]==c]
        r0=min(r for r,k in pts); r1=max(r for r,k in pts); k0=min(k for r,k in pts); k1=max(k for r,k in pts)
        if all((r in (r0,r1) or k in (k0,k1)) for r,k in pts):
            continue
        # detect bounding rectangle outline plus potentially interior marks
        if len(pts) < 2*(r1-r0+k1-k0): continue
        frames.append((c,r0,r1,k0,k1))
    # Replace interior of each frame with the inside pattern of a non-rectangular same-color frame, if one exists.
    # Actual rule: colors encode a source pattern in one frame, spread to its other frame.
    for c,r0,r1,k0,k1 in frames:
        inner=[(r,k) for r in range(r0+1,r1) for k in range(k0+1,k1)]
        if all(grid[r][k]==0 for r,k in inner):
            candidates=[f for f in frames if f[0]==c and f!= (c,r0,r1,k0,k1)]
            if candidates:
                _,a,b,x,y=candidates[0]
                for r,k in inner:
                    sr=a+1+(r-r0-1); sk=x+1+(k-k0-1)
                    if sr<b and sk<y: out[r][k]=grid[sr][sk]
    return out

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]; h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    # Identify objects whose interiors contain a nontrivial pattern; stamp their normalized pattern
    # into the other hollow frames, scaling by nearest-neighbor to the target interior.
    objs=[]
    for c in set(sum(grid,[]))-{0}:
        pts=[(r,k) for r in range(h) for k in range(w) if grid[r][k]==c]
        a=min(r for r,k in pts); b=max(r for r,k in pts); x=min(k for r,k in pts); y=max(k for r,k in pts)
        if b-a<2 or y-x<2: continue
        if all(grid[a][k]==c and grid[b][k]==c for k in range(x,y+1)) and all(grid[r][x]==c and grid[r][y]==c for r in range(a,b+1)):
            inner=[[grid[r][k] for k in range(x+1,y)] for r in range(a+1,b)]
            objs.append((c,a,b,x,y,inner))
    # Pattern-bearing interiors are copied to every empty framed object; preserve the frame color.
    sources=[o for o in objs if any(v for row in o[5] for v in row)]
